title: Trostani — Congregation of the Dürrenberg
summary: Populate the congregation: Trostani blesses each arrival with life and copies the best token until combat or Test of Endurance closes.

tags.name: populate
tags.reason: The commander, Growing Ranks, and a full populate package exist to copy creature tokens as the repeating action.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: The 99 is built to mint creature tokens so populate has a target; lands, enchantments, and creatures all make the flock.

tags.name: go-wide
tags.reason: Win texture is a visible army plus Overrun, True Conviction, or Ascension, not a single voltron body.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Trostani's toughness-life trigger is the blessing engine; Well of Lost Dreams and Test of Endurance pay it off.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck develops a board, trades, then converts with a telegraphed combat or ordeal rather than combo.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Dorks, Wild Growth, Signet, Lore/Visits, and Verge exist to cast GGWW Trostani on four or five.

tags.name: enchantress
tags.reason: Growing Ranks, Nest, Mesa, Privileged Position, and Test are enchantments, but the plan is tokens, not enchantress draw.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: No tax or lock pieces; Privileged Position is protection, not a lock.
